cues.text: Teachers, here's how to give your class a practice set.
Open Assignments and start a new one.
Tick the skills you want them to practise.
Preview a sample set, with each worked solution.
Give it a title, and save it as a draft.
Add your students' names. Each one gets their own link, and needs no account.
Copy a link to share it with that student, then send the assignment.
